title: Autoregressive Synthesis of Sparse and Semi-Structured Mixed-Type Data
summary: A reproduction package for a research paper on autoregressive synthesis of sparse and semi-structured mixed-type tabular/JSON data, providing a CLI pipeline to train, sample, and evaluate the proposed Origami model against several baseline synthesizers across datasets like adult, diabetes, and yelp. SDV's CTGAN and TVAE synthesizers (via sdv.single_table) are run as baseline comparisons, with sdv.metadata used to build the required table schema.
